summary: Grifols SA filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its Ordinary General Shareholders' Meeting held June 18, 2026. Shareholders approved all agenda items except item eleventh regarding authorization to call extraordinary meetings with 15 days' notice. The meeting approved a mandatory preferred dividend of EUR 0.01 per Class B share and an ordinary dividend of EUR 56,065,663 from fiscal year 2025 profits, both payable July 2, 2026. The Board re-elected two directors: Montserrat Muñoz Abellana and Susana González Rodríguez. This is a routine corporate governance update with no special situation transaction disclosed.
